verdict.rationale: Segment documents a tracking Spec that applies "across all of Segment's libraries and APIs." It lists official libraries spanning web (JavaScript), mobile (Kotlin/Android, Swift), and server (C#, Java). Its docs show an analytics.track call. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the identify and page calls in the evidence, per-SDK depth (install and usage docs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK behavior.
